title: Memphis rejects data center moratorium 6-6 but passes strict siting and water rules
summary: Memphis council deadlocked 6-6, rejecting a 12-month moratorium, but passed Ordinance 18. It bans evaporative and once-through cooling, requires closed-loop water and sets a schedule to phase out carbon electricity.
reason: Follow-up to the postponed vote: no moratorium, but binding local limits on data centers, a small backlash step.

title: Envision commissions GW-scale AI supercomputing campus in Ulanqab, China
summary: Envision commissioned a 120,000 sqm AI campus in Inner Mongolia designed for up to 1M accelerators and potentially more than 2 GW. It is the first step of a plan for 5 GW of desert AI capacity by 2030.
reason: Adds Chinese compute capacity; specs come from the company via trade press, so T1.
